crossRefs.note: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand and four…

parallels.note: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword…

translations.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
translations.asv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
